jobs.title: Senior Technical Specialist, AI Risk Assessment
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Specialist, AI Risk Assessment based in Australia.

This is a unique opportunity for an AI safety expert to contribute to cutting-edge research focused on understanding and managing the risks associated with increasingly capable AI systems. In this role, you will combine technical research, governance expertise, and rigorous analytical methods to develop advanced risk assessment frameworks. You will help shape methodologies that inform industry practices, policy discussions, and responsible AI development. Working within a highly collaborative and intellectually demanding environment, you will lead research initiatives, improve assessment approaches, and communicate complex AI risk concepts to diverse stakeholders.

Accountabilities

Develop advanced techniques for identifying AI risk pathways, including threat modeling approaches that capture technical, societal, and sociotechnical dimensions.
Design and improve comprehensive risk assessment methodologies for evaluating emerging AI systems, including potential loss-of-control and catastrophic risk scenarios.
Model complex risk propagation, amplification effects, threshold dynamics, and interactions across interconnected social and technical systems.
Provide strategic and technical quality assurance for research initiatives, ensuring analytical rigor, methodological soundness, and accuracy.
Lead original research projects focused on AI risk management, safety frameworks, and evaluation methodologies aligned with organizational objectives.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate risk assessment approaches across research programs and strategic initiatives.
Contribute to the development of technical standards, best practices, and frameworks for AI evaluation, risk measurement, and risk thresholds.
Translate complex research findings into clear, persuasive communications for technical experts, policymakers, and other stakeholders.
Support the advancement of responsible AI governance through innovative research and evidence-based recommendations.

Requirements

5+ years of experience in AI safety, AI alignment, AI governance, or related technical risk domains.
Strong understanding of advanced risk modeling approaches, including causal modeling, Bayesian networks, systems dynamics, or similar methodologies.
Experience analyzing complex systemic and sociotechnical risks, including risk propagation across interconnected systems.
Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to identify subtle weaknesses, assumptions, and limitations within complex technical arguments.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain advanced concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated expertise through research publications, technical contributions, or equivalent professional achievements.
Strong systems-thinking mindset with the ability to work independently and approach ambiguous challenges with intellectual rigor.
Experience collaborating in fast-paced, research-driven environments requiring creativity, precision, and continuous learning.
Comfort working with uncertainty and rapidly evolving knowledge landscapes.
Background in complex systems theory, control theory, cybernetics, multi-scale modeling, or dynamical systems is highly desirable.
Experience with AI safety organizations, technical research institutions, policy organizations, or adjacent risk fields is a plus.
Familiarity with causal models, Bayesian analysis, semi-quantitative frameworks, or hypergraph-based risk analysis is advantageous.

Benefits

Fully remote position with occasional travel opportunities.
Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking AI safety research with global impact.
Work alongside experts focused on advancing responsible AI development and governance.
Opportunity to influence emerging frameworks, standards, and policies related to AI risk management.
Flexible and intellectually stimulating work environment.
Ability to contribute to high-impact research initiatives addressing complex global challenges.
Collaborative culture focused on innovation, knowledge sharing, and rigorous analysis.
Opportunities for professional growth within a mission-driven research environment.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
